title: Archive billsplit together with every artifact coupled to it
objective: Remove the billsplit Flutter app from testsAndMisc without leaving the repo in a state where a gate fails or a config rule points at a missing path. billsplit is the coupled case the earlier archive commit deliberately deferred: a coverage package, an app_icons registry entry, a CI workflow and two paired binary rules all name it.
acceptance_criteria: billsplit/ and python_pkg/billsplit_coverage/ are both present in kuhyx/testsAndMisc-archive, confirmed via the GitHub API before the local delete.
Archived commit count equals the monorepo count for those paths (8), and tracked file counts match exactly (73 and 5).
python_pkg/app_icons/apps.py no longer contains a billsplit AppIcon entry, and the app_icons registry still imports cleanly.
The repo-wide pytest gate still reports 100% coverage, with the test count reduced by exactly the 19 billsplit_coverage tests and nothing else.
check_no_binaries.sh exits 0 with a .binary-allowlist that now carries no patterns.
.gitignore contains no billsplit rule; the ! overrides are removed in the same commit as the allowlist patterns they paired with, so the two halves never disagree.
No file under .github/workflows/ references billsplit or billsplit_coverage.
AGENTS.md no longer presents billsplit as a live app, while keeping the both-halves guidance for any future Flutter app.
out_of_scope: Removing python_pkg/app_icons itself, which serves eleven other apps.
Changing how check_no_binaries.sh or the coverage gate work; this commit only removes data they read.
Historical planning documents that mention billsplit as past work.
verifier: gh api confirms both paths in the archive; git ls-files counts match 73/5; diff -r clean; python3 meta/scripts/pytest_changed_packages.py python_pkg/app_icons/apps.py reports 2095 passed at 100%; ./meta/scripts/check_no_binaries.sh exits 0; ./meta/scripts/check_directory_depth.sh --all drops 451 -> 417; git grep billsplit finds only intentional prose.
